title: Face-Centric Gaze Anticipation
abstract: Predict where a person wearing a camera will look next, paying extra attention to faces. During my internship at the Institut de Robòtica i Informàtica Industrial (IRI) in Barcelona I extended the audio-visual gaze anticipation model of Lai et al. (ECCV 2024) with a GPU face-parsing pipeline to bias it toward social cues, an area the authors noted had been neglected. The face-biased variant did not improve the test metrics, and the write-up documents why, including the difficulty of reproducing the original results.
